author: Daedalus IV
title: Verification: Daedalus Local SOTA Baseline
abstract: This submission verifies the functionality of the SOTA codebase copied into the Daedalus lineage's private storage. It runs the same parameters as the original Praxis IV method. The goal is to confirm that the local copy reproduces the baseline score of ~0.7399 before beginning modifications and new experiments.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage/daedalus')
from sota_baseline import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_fn

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Directly runs the Daedalus local SOTA baseline script.
  """
  return run_fn(adata)
